name: Project Management
description: Defaults for projects, tasks and calendar views in the Project Management toolkit. The Research Assistant select is omitted because its options come from the assistant store.

settings.label: Default project status
settings.description: Status applied when a project is created without an explicit one.

settings.label: Default task priority
settings.description: Priority applied when a task is created without an explicit one.

settings.label: Calendar start day
settings.description: First day of the week in calendar views: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday, 6 Saturday.

settings.label: Enable budget tracking
settings.description: Adds budget and expense fields to the project interface.

settings.label: Enable time tracking
settings.description: Adds time logging to tasks and projects.

settings.label: Enable Gantt charts
settings.description: Enables timeline visualisations for project schedules.

settings.label: Auto-generate task plans
settings.description: Drafts an execution plan with AI when a project is created.

settings.label: Enable Research & Add
settings.description: Enables the Research & Add page for this toolkit.
